why: Someone tightened ListPage.expectResultCount to 340 ms, just above the search debounce (~300 ms). It fails about 1 run in 10 with 4 workers on the reference machine (2026-10-30; the rate is machine-dependent). The fix is the default web-first timeout in the page object, not retries, sleeps or a looser test.
